== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (Japanese)|Self-Destruct Mechanism]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944010/LJvT-gIyTkmhO3hK4p46Hg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099881.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c4632d4f85d6e4e43865a3e6694429f4c869b9eb7b7c19d6d1e8900eef77a5c7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
